name: perplexity-search
title: Perplexity Search
description: Search the web with the Perplexity Search API and open results from Raycast.
author: james_liounis

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search the Web
commands.description: Search the web with Perplexity Search and open results.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Perplexity API Key
preferences.description: Your Perplexity API key. Create one at https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results
preferences.description: Number of results to return per query (1–20).

preferences.name: country
preferences.title: Country
preferences.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to bias results (e.g. US, GB, FR).

preferences.name: recency
preferences.title: Recency Filter
preferences.description: Optionally restrict results by how recently they were published.
